job.job_title: Python AI Engineer GenAI LLM RAG Mumbai
job.job_description:
Position: Python AI Engineer
Location: Mumbai
Experience: 35 Years

Must Have:

Strong hands-on experience in Python
Experience developing AI/GenAI applications
Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG and Prompt Engineering
Experience with LangChain / LangGraph / LlamaIndex
Knowledge of Embeddings & Vector Databases
Experience with FastAPI / Flask / REST APIs
Good understanding of NLP / Machine Learning
Experience with OpenAI / Azure OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic or similar LLMs
Good knowledge of SQL

Good to Have:

Agentic AI / AI Agents
Docker / Kubernetes
AWS / Azure / GCP
CI/CD and production deployment experience

Key Responsibilities:

Build and deploy Python-based AI/GenAI applications
Develop RAG pipelines and LLM-powered solutions
Integrate AI models with APIs and enterprise applications
Work on prompt engineering, evaluation and AI workflow automation
Collaborate with engineering and business teams to deliver production-ready AI solutions
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience and transferable cloud skills.
